sources.authored_capsule: The current v2 paper allows useful reasoning/actions while input or environment information is pending, supports changing speculative work, and requires final input before final answer. It studies real-time tool-calling, not this research pipeline; reported speedups and any accuracy loss are not acceptable evidence for B12 quality. B12 transfers only bounded preparatory writing, late correction and the final-input gate.

sources.authored_capsule: This preprint distinguishes starting downstream work while required upstream information is pending and staging a draft until its assumptions can be resolved. Failed speculation consumes work. B12 uses the one-off schedule idea without the paper's probability, money model, routing, calibration or framework; no synthetic result is treated as an executed research-workflow gain.
